name: 1pcs Silicone Hair Shampoo Brush Mini Scalp Massager
description:
1pcs Silicone Hair Shampoo Brush Mini Scalp Massager 

Made of environmental protection silicone material. 
It provides gentle stimulation to increase the blood circulation for daily health care with comfortable and relaxing feeling. 
Helps to relieve your tension and and daily working stresspromote a good sleep. 
Helps to remove dandruff and dirt and prevent hair loss by scalp stimulation. 
Extreme deep care for scalp helpful for hair growth. 
Descriptions: 
Convex point design full contact with the hair shampoo deep clean. 
It can be used in showeror as a head massager or body massager outside of the shower.
